The '''13th Critics' Choice Awards''' were presented on January 7, 2008, at the [[Santa Monica Civic Auditorium]], honoring the finest achievements of [[2007 in film|2007 filmmaking]].<ref>{{cite web |url=https://www.hollywoodreporter.com/business/business-news/bcast-critics-flag-planted-no-102036/ |title=B'cast Critics flag planted in 'No Country' |first1=Borys |last1=Kit |first2=Gregg |last2=Kilday |work=[[The Hollywood Reporter]] |publisher=[[Prometheus Global Media]] |date=January 8, 2008 |access-date=January 8, 2008}}</ref> The ceremony was broadcast on [[VH1]] and hosted by [[D. L. Hughley]].<ref>{{cite web |url=http://www.thefutoncritic.com/news/2007/11/29/dl-hughley-to-host-the-13th-annual-critics-choice-awards-on-vh1--26105/20071129vh101/ |title=D.L. Hughley to Host 'The 13th Annual Critics' Choice Awards' on VH1 |work=[[The Futon Critic]] |date=November 29, 2007 |access-date=November 29, 2007}}</ref> The nominees were announced on December 11, 2007.<ref>{{cite web |url=https://variety.com/2007/film/awards/critics-choice-awards-nominations-1117977491/ |title=Critics' Choice Awards nominations |author=Variety Staff |work=[[Variety (magazine)|Variety]] |publisher=[[Penske Media Corporation]] |date=December 11, 2007 |access-date=December 11, 2007}}</ref>
